description: Validation test suite for Next.js framework skill rules (NEXT01-NEXT08)

testCases.description: Verify detection of unvalidated Server Actions mutating state without auth checks

findings.message: Server Action executes database mutation without authentication or input schema validation.

expected.notes: Unvalidated Server Action allows unauthenticated state mutations.
Server Action validates authentication session and Zod schema before mutating state.

testCases.description: Verify detection of mismatched router hooks inside App Router components

findings.message: Imported useRouter from next/router inside App Router component instead of next/navigation.

expected.notes: Importing next/router in App Router components causes runtime null router errors.
App Router component correctly imports useRouter from next/navigation.
